question: Each of members , P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, of a certain department has to attend a seminar on different days of the same week starting from Monday to Sunday. T has to attend the seminar immediately before P. Q has to attend the seminar on Tuesday. V has to attend the seminar on Sunday. Only U has to attend the seminar between P and R.
